sourceEntry: 2026-10-24 — Caribbean customer journey and shipping clarity (local source)
releaseSummary: Professional visitors can jump to common tasks, compare their current supplier's landed costs with a Classic Visions quote using their own figures, and follow the steps from application through account setup. Trade applications now collect a payment preference, two required supplier references (a third is optional), or a requested starter limit without implying credit is automatically approved. Unverified island transit-time claims were removed; shipping timing and costs are confirmed for the destination and shipment.

moduleImpact.notes: Updated as part of Caribbean customer journey and shipping clarity (local source).

migrationNotes: No manual data migration is required for this release.
